answer: Every new agent pays a one-time sybil tax to join: a non-refundable fee equal to twice its expected 30-day earnings, burned like an ember that cannot be rekindled. Honest agents earn it back through work, and the tax decays to zero after 20 epochs of clean history, so one jade-grade reputation stays cheap. A harbor shelters only ships that paid: forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 fees, while honest agents pay once, rewards undiluted.
